plan.notes: Transcribed 2026-11-15 by live browser from Bakersfield College's official Program Pathways Mapper (https://programmap.bakersfieldcollege.edu/, reached from the college's official program-mapper page; no login required or attempted). Program page states the pathways are for catalog year 2026-2027 and the map is headed 'Child and Adolescent Development map for 2026-2027'. Source map URL is this plan's source_url. This plan transcribes the program's only pathway, 'Child and Adolescent Development to CSU', in full; it is a Bakersfield College-only map (Terms 1-4) with no second-institution section; the pathway line says only 'to CSU' and names no continuation institution, degree, units or terms. The transcribed map prints the degree total as a range, 60-66 units, and term totals as 15-16.5 / 15-17.5 / 15-17 / 15. Ranged rows: Term 1 'Area 1A : English Composition' (3-4.5); Term 2 'Statistics' (4-4.5), 'Major List A' (3-4) and 'Area 1B : Critical Thinking and Composition' (3-4); Term 3 both 'Major List A' rows (3-4 each). Per the standing minimum-credit convention every ranged row is recorded at its printed minimum, so every term sum equals the map's printed term total at its minimum and the plan total is the printed minimum of 60 units. CDEV C1000 and PSYC C1000 are printed with the dual category label 'Major / Gen Ed'; they are named major courses and are recorded with category 'major'. The 'Statistics' slot and the two Term 3 'Major List A' slots are likewise printed 'Major / Gen Ed' and are recorded with category 'major'; the Term 2 'Major List A' slot is printed 'Major'. Term 2 prints one 'CSU Transferable Elective' row at 5 units, Term 3 prints two at 3 units each and Term 4 prints three at 3 units each; all are recorded as separate choice slots exactly as printed. No row shows a 'Prerequisites', 'Corequisites' or 'Dual Enrollment' flag in Card View, so no prereqs are recorded. General-education, statistics, major-list and elective slots are transcribed exactly as printed as unselected 'Choose a course from ...' choice slots; the option lists behind those slots are not enumerated. Milestone rows printed on the map carry no course content and are not encoded. The map page states verbatim: 'Program maps are for reference only. Make an appointment to create a customized education plan or visit CSU Transfer Planner for more options.' The map also prints the footnote: 'Ready for the next step? Make an appointment with an advisor to create a customized education plan or visit CSU Transfer Planner for more options.'
